BiblicalUsage: The word rôq means spittle. It stands in Isaiah 50:6, "…cheeks to them that plucked off the hair…", and in Job 7:19, "How long wilt thou not depart from me…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put rôq here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
